findings.section: Why this shape, and what was rejected — An expanded word is any text
findings.summary: The example of a harmless command C2 denies, `vloop task show "$id"` under a fence that denies `vloop task done:*`, is not denied by C2: the expanded word comes after the literal `show`, so `vloop task show <any text>` can never begin with `vloop task done`. No fence has a `vloop task done:*` rule either.
findings.evidence: C2: a command is denied when some text in place of the expanded words makes a deny rule match; `pre:*` matches the prefix alone or followed by a space (internal/fence/judge.go patternMatch). fence/*.json hold `vloop task verify:*`, `reset`, `note`, `drop`, `set`, and no `vloop task done:*` (grep -rn 'task done' fence/ prints nothing).
findings.fix: Replace the example with one C2 does deny, for example `vloop task "$verb" T1` (denied through `Bash(vloop task verify:*)`), or delete it: the `git diff "$BASE" --stat` and `find "$d" -name x` examples that follow already make the point.

findings.summary: `env ! git status → deny: shell syntax ! cannot be judged` sits under `# C2` but pins a C1 decision ("a keyword after a wrapper is not dropped"), and it is already today's answer. Task 2's gate on "its lines" would carry a C1 line.
findings.evidence: Decided here: "A keyword after a wrapper is not dropped: `env ! x` stays denied". The base binary answers `deny: shell syntax ! cannot be judged` for this line in the work phase today.
findings.fix: Move the line under `# C1, what is inside is judged`, so task 1's gate pins it together with the rule it tests.

decisions: Drop the leading keyword and judge the rest, with no shell grammar and no mvdan.cc/sh. Sound: the splitter already cuts at every operator, so each command a compound can run reaches the judge.
case, select, function, coproc and [[ stay refused. Agreed: none of them appears among the counted denials.

An expanded word ($, glob, brace) stands for any text, and is not resolved. Agreed. The cost is measured for `$` only (5 of 52 kept calls, none denied). Unquoted globs are not counted: with them, every `git diff`, `git log`, `git show` and `find` command is denied, because of the inner-`*` rules (`git log --oneline -- docs/*.md`, `find internal -name *_test.go`). Acceptable, since a retry with quotes passes, but this is the likeliest new false denial.
A command name that expands anywhere in it is refused, not only one that starts with `$`. Agreed: it closes `g$X push` and `/usr/bin/$X push`.
An expanded word that a wrapper skips refuses the command (`nice -n $N push origin`). Agreed: it closes a real bypass.
Redirection targets holding a glob stay judged as written. Agreed: not a new hole, since `tee .git/hooks/pre-commit` is allowed in a work session today and the driver stays the boundary (S-2).
`command -v`/`-V` (and -pv, -vp) run nothing, only when written literally. Agreed.
Subshells are read too, with a redirection allowed after `)` but no word. Agreed.
The order inside a command (keywords, then assignments and wrappers) and `env ! x` staying refused. Agreed.
The decisions were taken under the operator's delegation of 2026-11-02, not seen by the operator one by one.
checked: facts (split.go, judge.go, judge_test.go, review_brief_test.go, internal/cli fence tests, fence/*.json rules, the Copilot deny list, the doc sentences C4 rewrites in configuration.md, fence-audit.md and fence.go help, the denial counts 9 if / 5 for / 2 subshells against copilot-cli-experiments.md, the uncommitted kept-sessions section, the domain glossary row and S-2); every worked-example line walked against the contract and the real rule order, with the base binary run for the lines claimed as today's answers; consistency (the summary against the contract, C2 against C3, the test exceptions in the constraints); runnability (task order against the single go check: task 1 needs only the two named test changes, task 2 turns no existing test red, command -$v deferred to task 2; verify runs only vloop fence check); rules (no new dependency, repo-relative paths, depends-on B34 is consumed). vloop brief check on a ready copy: ok, 0 warnings.
